# Reference Letter
For: Ms. Elena Vogt
Date: 10 November 2026

To whom it may concern,

We hereby confirm that Ms. Elena Vogt was employed by Northgate Cloud Systems GmbH, Berlin, from 01 March 2022 to 30 September 2026.

Ms. Vogt joined us as a Junior DevOps Engineer in the Platform Team. From January 2024, she held the position of DevOps Engineer. Her responsibilities included maintaining our Kubernetes clusters, building and improving CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI, writing Terraform modules for cloud environments, and monitoring production systems with Prometheus and Grafana. She also supported incident response and documented runbooks for the platform team.

Ms. Vogt carried out her duties independently, reliably and with a high degree of technical understanding. She worked in a structured manner, paid attention to detail and remained calm and focused during production incidents. Her work contributed significantly to reducing deployment times and improving the stability of our platform. She was also able to explain complex technical matters clearly to colleagues from other teams.

Her conduct toward supervisors, colleagues and external partners was always professional, friendly and cooperative. She was a valued member of the team and was respected for her commitment and willingness to help.

Ms. Vogt left our company at her own request. We thank her for her successful work and wish her continued professional and personal success.

Berlin, 10 November 2026

Northgate Cloud Systems GmbH

Dr. Martin Reuter
Head of Platform Engineering
